approval.source: owner-confirmed canonical K998 and K399 originals; no generated output approval

axes.keep: Controlled darker hair, brows and silhouette contours; finer economical nose, lip, jaw and garment interior marks in both K998 and K399.
axes.drop: Uniform thick comic outlines, doubled sketch contours or pervasive cheek hatching.

axes.keep: Broad matte garment planes with limited smooth skin transitions and clear plane boundaries. Recipient or authored colors remain authoritative.
axes.drop: Photographic pores, glossy plastic skin, grain-filled flat ochre or exemplar palette transfer.

axes.keep: Connected warm midtone jaw-to-neck shadow groups and broad restrained garment folds, as in both originals.
axes.drop: Near-black neck triangles, many black fold splinters, cinematic rim lighting or over-modeled tiny folds.

axes.keep: Stylized clear eyes and economical nose and mouth marks; preserve each recipient individual face proportions, eye aperture and identity.
axes.drop: Averaged faces, copied exemplar geometry, enlarged glossy eyes as a global rule or photoreal pore detail.

axes.keep: Broad overlapping shaded hair clumps with sparse loose strands and quiet cloth fields, shared by K998 and K399.
axes.drop: Dense luminous hair threads, pervasive woven grain, paper noise, bright scratches or global hatching.

roleExclusions: Both anchors are style-only for both genders and both input modes; neither supplies identity, face geometry, palette, pose, gaze, head turn, framing, anatomy or garments.
K399 opaque blue background is not the desired output background. Preserve the existing transparent-background and opaque-person-interior delivery contract.
K998 glasses, swept hair and brown jacket; K399 bob, larger eyes, lip highlight and olive jacket are local content, not mandatory shared traits.
